d: Reporting to: Head of Compliance & AML/CTF

To support the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (AML/CTF) framework at BSI Overseas Branch – KSA, ensuring compliance with SAMA regulatory requirements, applicable laws and regulations, and internal policies through effective risk assessments, transaction monitoring, regulatory reporting, and compliance controls, while promoting a strong AML/CTF compliance culture across the Bank’s business activities and operational units.
q: Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in AML/CTF within the banking or financial services sector.
In-depth knowledge of SAMA regulatory requirements and applicable Saudi AML/CTF laws and regulations.
Sound knowledge of banking products, services, and business processes.
Comprehensive understanding of AML/CTF risk assessments, customer due diligence, customer risk classification, and transaction monitoring.
Experience with AML/CTF monitoring systems, regulatory reporting, and compliance controls.
Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and report-writing skills.
Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and maintain a high level of accuracy and confidentiality.
Proficiency in both Arabic and English.
Relevant professional certifications, such as CCO, CAMS, or equivalent AML/CTF qualifications, are preferred.
r: Promote and strengthen the AML/CTF compliance culture across all relevant business units, operational functions, and banking activities, in coordination with Head Office.
Monitor regulatory instructions and circulars, maintain an updated regulatory requirements register, and identify necessary implementation actions.
Develop, review, and update AML/CTF policies, procedures, guidelines, and operational forms for management review.
Conduct gap assessments between Saudi regulatory requirements and Head Office policies and recommend appropriate remediation measures.

Coordinate with the Head Office Compliance Management Unit to ensure effective implementation and alignment of AML/CTF practices at BSI Overseas Branch – KSA with applicable local regulatory requirements.
Implement AML/CTF compliance action plans and monitor progress, deliverables, and implementation challenges.
Conduct and update Business-Wide Risk Assessments, including the assessment of inherent risks, control effectiveness, and residual risks.
Develop and review customer risk classification methodologies, risk factors, weightings, and assessment outcomes.
Assess AML/CTF risks associated with new products, services, delivery channels, and technologies prior to their launch.
Review compliance with Know Your Customer (KYC), Ultimate Beneficial Owner, Customer Due Diligence, Enhanced Due Diligence, and customer information update requirements.
Assess prospective customers, counterparties, proposed business relationships, and transactions presenting high AML/CTF risks, and provide appropriate recommendations to authorized decision-makers.
Monitor high-risk customers and Politically Exposed Persons, ensuring that required approvals are obtained from authorized personnel.
Coordinate with relevant departments to address deficiencies in customer information and supporting documentation.
Prepare AML/CTF questionnaires for correspondent banks and other financial institutions, including supporting documentation for approval.
Define regulatory and functional requirements for AML/CTF monitoring systems and coordinate their implementation.
Develop and enhance transaction monitoring scenarios, detection indicators, and thresholds, ensuring appropriate documentation and justification.
Verify data completeness, system integration, and the alignment of customer risk classifications with transaction monitoring systems.
Conduct operational and periodic testing of AML/CTF systems and monitoring scenarios, document findings, and follow up on remediation actions.
Monitor alert volumes, backlogs, processing turnaround times, and transaction monitoring quality indicators.
Review, analyze, and investigate transaction monitoring alerts and potentially suspicious activities, document investigation findings, and escalate cases in accordance with approved procedures.
Compile transaction analysis findings and prepare reports on AML/CTF activities at BSI Overseas Branch – KSA.
Utilize case outcomes and identified suspicious patterns to enhance monitoring scenarios and AML/CTF controls.
Develop and implement suspicious activity reporting and escalation procedures, and prepare supporting documentation for review and decision-making by the designated reporting officer.
Conduct AML/CTF compliance reviews and on-site visits across relevant departments and branches, where applicable, and prepare related reports.
Monitor regulatory and internal findings, verify corrective actions and supporting evidence, and recommend closure where appropriate.
Prepare regulatory reports, statistics, questionnaires, and responses required by SAMA and other competent authorities.
Ensure that regulatory reporting obligations are fulfilled accurately, fairly, completely, and within the prescribed timelines, in accordance with applicable requirements and approved procedures.
Follow up on regulatory requests and coordinate with relevant authorities within approved delegated powers.
Develop, deliver, and evaluate AML/CTF training and awareness programs, ensuring proper documentation and recordkeeping.

Establish and maintain effective collaboration with relevant internal and external stakeholders to enhance AML/CTF activities at BSI Overseas Branch – KSA, and evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of such collaboration.
Maintain accurate and confidential records of AML/CTF activities, assessments, correspondence, and review documentation, ensuring accessibility and retrievability.
Coordinate with the Targeted Financial Sanctions, Anti-Fraud, and SSU functions on matters of mutual relevance.

Handling Braxtone Club Program and expanding the service provider network.

Collection and analyze data of the market.

relationship management with our customers (insurance, broker, rental cars, and agencies, others...)
arranging meeting with potential client (insurance, broker, and agency’s; others)

handling complaints of our customers along with office admin.
